progress.scan_bus: Scanning the RS485 bus with safe read-only requests.

address_method.description: Choose how battery addresses are added.
address_method.title: Battery addresses

data_description.slave_addresses: Comma-separated decimal or 0x-prefixed addresses, for example 0xD6, 0xD7.

manual.description: Every entered address is validated with safe read-only requests before the entry is created.
manual.title: Enter battery addresses

data_description.scan_addresses: Comma-separated decimal or 0x-prefixed addresses. The default matches Huawei's 0xD6–0xDD and 0xE0–0xE7 scan set.
data_description.scan_rounds: Every selected address is probed once per round, including addresses that already responded.

scan.description: Each probe is a safe read of register 0x0000. One valid response is enough to discover a battery.
scan.title: Scan the RS485 bus

data_description.slave_addresses: Select one or more responding batteries to add.

scan_result.description: The listed addresses returned a valid Modbus RTU response.
scan_result.title: Select discovered batteries

data_description.response_timeout: Maximum seconds to receive one complete Modbus RTU response. This is not the polling interval.
data_description.serial_port: Use a stable /dev/serial/by-id path when available.
data_description.enable_control_entities: Disabled by default. Enabling allows validated register writes that can change persistent battery settings.

serial.description: Configure a local USB or serial RS485 adapter.
serial.title: Serial RTU

data_description.connect_timeout: Maximum seconds allowed to establish the TCP connection.
data_description.response_timeout: Maximum seconds to receive one complete Modbus RTU response after connecting. This is not the polling interval.
data_description.enable_control_entities: Disabled by default. Enabling allows validated register writes that can change persistent battery settings.

tcp.description: The gateway must transparently forward complete Modbus RTU frames including CRC.
tcp.title: TCP RTU transparent gateway

reconfigure.description: Choose the connection type, then validate connection details and battery addresses again. The active integration is paused while the bus is validated or scanned so only one Home Assistant connection can use the RS485 bus.
reconfigure.title: Reconfigure Huawei ESM-48100

user.description: Choose how Home Assistant connects to the RS485 bus.
user.title: Huawei ESM-48100

data_description.enable_control_entities: Disabled by default. Enabling allows validated register writes that can change persistent battery settings.
data_description.keepalive_interval: Seconds between lightweight read-only keepalive checks. The recommended value is 10 seconds.
data_description.update_interval: Seconds between complete battery snapshots. Increasing this reduces Recorder data volume.

init.description: Configure runtime collection and safety behavior.
init.title: Huawei ESM-48100 options
